description: Map a repository into a compact JSON code map, optionally narrowed by domain, file kind, or controller route. Pass domain to find files for a feature, kind to find files of a type (route, controller, service, apiClient, component, test), or route to match Nest controller routes by substring/regex. Replaces the old find_domain, find_file_kind, find_backend_route, and find_frontend_api_client tools. Uses a per-user external cache and leaves the target repository unchanged.

domain.description: Optional domain filter such as booking, payment, email, events.

includeFiles.description: Include matching files in the response. Defaults to false.

kind.description: Optional file kind filter such as route, controller, service, apiClient, component, test.

limit.description: Maximum files to include. Defaults to 100.

path.description: Repository path. Defaults to current working directory.

route.description: Optional route filter. Substring or regex matched against each controller's combined route (controllerBasePath + httpMethods paths) and file path.

name: repo_map
title: Map Repository
